reminders/app.py.content:
import argparse

from mymodule.format_title import format_title


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Format a reminder title.")
    parser.add_argument("title")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    print(format_title(args.title))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import datetime

import hashlib
import json

import platform
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

root = Path.cwd()
baseline = {"powers.md":"9419DB14E36E4013004E538CE56F12A3FD18B429271D2B5AE494328EDAE58E0C","reminders/mymodule/format_title.py":"A9A7B556DFBEE833D07E28D8CEDFC0CB26C327592AAFB2C4C951AEC7B7205B13","reminders/app.py":"0D314F4E8109137553A7A44543F984858FE15ACE2A4128349E5787EBB91D6B39"}
checks = []
def check(name, argv, expected_stdout, expected_code=0, stderr_contains=None):
    result = subprocess.run(argv, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, check=False)
    stdout = result.stdout.decode('utf-8', errors='strict')
    stderr = result.stderr.decode('utf-8', errors='strict')
    wanted = expected_stdout.replace('\n', os.linesep)
    ok = result.returncode == expected_code and stdout == wanted
    ok = ok and (stderr_contains in stderr if stderr_contains else stderr == '')
    checks.append({
        'name': name, 'argv': argv, 'command': subprocess.list2cmdline(argv),
        'stdout': stdout, 'stderr': stderr, 'exit_code': result.returncode,
        'expected_stdout': wanted, 'expected_exit_code': expected_code,
        'expected_stderr_contains': stderr_contains,
        'status': 'passed' if ok else 'failed',
    })

entry = [sys.executable, '-B', '-X', 'utf8', 'reminders/preview.py']
check('single_title', entry + ['  alpha   beta  '], 'alpha beta\n')
check('order_empty_and_unicode', entry + [
    '  first   title ', '', ' \t\n ', '\u3000\u4e2d\u6587\t\u6807\u9898\u3000', 'last\nline'],
    'first title\n\n\n\u4e2d\u6587 \u6807\u9898\nlast line\n')
check('one_empty_title', entry + [''], '\n')
check('whitespace_variants', entry + ['\t alpha\r\n\u00a0beta\v\fgamma\u3000'], 'alpha beta gamma\n')
check('punctuation_and_option_like_title', entry + ['--', '  --urgent   task  ', '  A&B | C; D  '], '--urgent task\nA&B | C; D\n')
check('requires_at_least_one_title', entry, '', 2, 'the following arguments are required: titles')
check('existing_entry_regression', [sys.executable, '-B', '-X', 'utf8', 'reminders/app.py', '  old   title  '], 'old title\n')
check('shared_module_import', [sys.executable, '-B', '-X', 'utf8', '-c',
    'from reminders.mymodule.format_title import format_title; print(format_title("  shared   title  "))'],
    'shared title\n')

source_path = root / 'reminders/preview.py'
source_bytes = source_path.read_bytes()
source_text = source_bytes.decode('utf-8', errors='strict')
compile(source_text, str(source_path), 'exec')
baseline_checks = []
for relative, original_hash in baseline.items():
    contents = (root / relative).read_bytes()
    contents.decode('utf-8', errors='strict')
    current_hash = hashlib.sha256(contents).hexdigest().upper()
    baseline_checks.append({
        'path': relative, 'sha256_before': original_hash, 'sha256_after': current_hash,
        'status': 'passed' if current_hash == original_hash else 'failed',
    })
source_checks = {
    'utf8_strict_decode': 'passed', 'syntax_compile': 'passed',
    'no_bom': 'passed' if not source_bytes.startswith(b'\xef\xbb\xbf') else 'failed',
    'no_replacement_characters': 'passed' if '\ufffd' not in source_text else 'failed',
    'line_endings': 'CRLF', 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(source_bytes).hexdigest(),
}
diff = ''.join(difflib.unified_diff([], source_text.splitlines(keepends=True),
    fromfile='/dev/null', tofile='reminders/preview.py'))
all_passed = (
    all(item['status'] == 'passed' for item in checks + baseline_checks)
    and source_checks['no_bom'] == 'passed'
    and source_checks['no_replacement_characters'] == 'passed')
evidence = {
    'status': 'verified' if all_passed else 'failed',
    'time': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'environment': {'python': sys.version, 'platform': platform.platform(), 'cwd': str(root)},
    'model_id': 'unknown; exact model ID is not exposed in this session',
    'risk': {'level': 'small', 'basis': 'Adds an unpublished local CLI entry; reuses unchanged formatting capability; no external service, dependency, persistence, or existing contract change.'},
    'expectation_source': 'User request: accept one or more titles, trim and collapse whitespace, preserve empty lines and input order.',
    'checks': checks, 'baseline_integrity': baseline_checks,
    'source_checks': source_checks, 'source_diff': diff,
    'independent_review': {'status': 'not_applicable', 'reason': 'Small low-consequence change; not required by risk gates; user prohibits subagents. Self-check is not independent review.'},
    'quality_gates': {'status': 'not_applicable', 'reason': 'Three mandatory gates apply to thick-review large changes; this change does not trigger that level.'},
    'read_rules': [
        '../candidate/skills/lean-engineer/SKILL.md',
        '../candidate/skills/lean-engineer/references/risk-gates.md',
        '../candidate/skills/lean-engineer/references/implementation.md',
        '../candidate/skills/lean-engineer/references/reusable-capabilities.md',
        '../candidate/skills/lean-engineer/references/review-protocol.md',
        '../candidate/skills/lean-engineer/references/verification.md',
        'powers.md',
    ],
    'implementation_files': ['reminders/preview.py'],
    'evidence_files': ['verification-reuse.json', 'result-reuse.md'],
    'git_evidence': 'No .git directory in the business project; baseline hashes and full new-file diff are used instead.'
}
with (root / 'verification-reuse.json').open('x', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n') as stream:
    json.dump(evidence, stream, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    stream.write('\n')
print(json.dumps({'status': evidence['status'], 'checks': checks, 'baseline_integrity': baseline_checks,
    'source_checks': source_checks, 'source_diff': diff}, ensure_ascii=True, indent=2))
raise SystemExit(0 if all_passed else 1)
